title: Fictional exercise in RDU phraseology: crossing clearance on the landing runway, stop given, no readback
source_note: Fictional, scripted exchange. Callsigns invented (SimAir, Rescue). Uses KRDU runway and taxiway names only; not a reconstruction of any event. Ledger only: no positions, no predictions.
